headword: {屋上|おくじょう}{庭園|ていえん}

definitions.explanation: A garden or green space built on the roof of a building. Found on department stores, office buildings, and residences, providing a place to relax or grow plants in urban areas.

examples.japanese: デパートの{屋上|おくじょう}{庭園|ていえん}。
ビルの{屋上|おくじょう}{庭園|ていえん}で{昼食|ちゅうしょく}を{取|と}った。
examples.english: I had lunch in the building's rooftop garden.

examples.japanese: {都市|とし}の{緑化|りょくか}{対策|たいさく}として、{屋上|おくじょう}{庭園|ていえん}を{設置|せっち}する{企業|きぎょう}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: As an urban greening measure, more companies are installing rooftop gardens.

notes:
A compound of {屋上|おくじょう} (rooftop) and {庭園|ていえん} (garden). Rooftop gardens are found throughout Japanese cities, particularly on department stores and commercial buildings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {屋上|おくじょう}{庭園|ていえん}を{設置|せっち}する: to install a rooftop garden
- {屋上|おくじょう}{庭園|ていえん}の{設計|せっけい}: rooftop garden design
- {屋上|おくじょう}{緑化|りょくか}: rooftop greening

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {屋上|おくじょう}: rooftop — the location itself, without necessarily having a garden
- {庭園|ていえん}: garden — a garden at ground level
- {屋上|おくじょう}{菜園|さいえん}: rooftop vegetable garden — specifically for growing food

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many Japanese department stores traditionally have rooftop spaces, though these were originally used for amusement areas and playgrounds rather than gardens. Modern rooftop gardens serve both aesthetic and environmental purposes, helping to reduce the urban heat island effect.
